summary: Cross Country Healthcare filed an 8-K disclosing a special meeting to approve its merger with KL Criss Cross Intermediate, LLC, where Merger Sub merges into the Company, making it a wholly-owned subsidiary of Parent—a going-private transaction. The special meeting is set for July 16, 2026, for stockholders of record as of June 12, 2026. The board is seeking stockholder approval; advisors are not named. The deal is expected to close in Q3 2026, subject to conditions including stockholder vote. Two lawsuits have been filed alleging inadequate proxy disclosures, and demand letters have been received. Watch for supplemental disclosures or potential settlement of litigation to facilitate closing, and monitor the stockholder vote outcome for risk-arb considerations.
